UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; ROOT='{{$FullBaseDir}}'; MOD='{{GameDir}}'; OUT=\"$ROOT/installed-maps.txt\"; TMP=\"$ROOT/.installed-maps.tmp\"; : > \"$TMP\"; scan_dir() { D=\"$1\"; [[ -d \"$D\" ]] || return 0; if [[ -d \"$D/maps\" ]]; then find \"$D/maps\" -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.bsp' -printf '%f\\n' 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's/\\.[bB][sS][pP]$//' >> \"$TMP\"; fi; for P in \"$D\"/*.pak; do [[ -f \"$P\" ]] || continue; grep -aEio 'maps/[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+\\.bsp' \"$P\" 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#^[mM][aA][pP][sS]/##; s/\\.[bB][sS][pP]$//' >> \"$TMP\" || true; done; for Z in \"$D\"/*.pkz; do [[ -f \"$Z\" ]] || continue; unzip -Z1 \"$Z\" 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '^maps/[^/]+\\.bsp$' | sed -E 's#^maps/##I; s/\\.[bB][sS][pP]$//' >> \"$TMP\" || true; done; }; scan_dir \"$ROOT/baseq2\"; if [[ \"$MOD\" != 'baseq2' ]]; then scan_dir \"$ROOT/$MOD\"; fi; LC_ALL=C sort -fu \"$TMP\" > \"$OUT\"; rm -f \"$TMP\"; COUNT=$(wc -l < \"$OUT\" | tr -d ' '); echo \"Detected $COUNT Quake II maps from baseq2${MOD:+ + $MOD}. List: $OUT\""

-c "set -e; FLAGS=0; [[ '{{DM_NoHealth}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 1)); [[ '{{DM_NoItems}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 2)); [[ '{{DM_WeaponsStay}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 4)); [[ '{{DM_NoFalling}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 8)); [[ '{{DM_InstantItems}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 16)); [[ '{{DM_SameLevel}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 32)); [[ '{{DM_SkinTeams}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 64)); [[ '{{DM_ModelTeams}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 128)); [[ '{{DM_NoFriendlyFire}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 256)); [[ '{{DM_SpawnFarthest}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 512)); [[ '{{DM_ForceRespawn}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 1024)); [[ '{{DM_NoArmor}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 2048)); [[ '{{DM_AllowExit}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 4096)); [[ '{{DM_InfiniteAmmo}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 8192)); [[ '{{DM_QuadDrop}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 16384)); [[ '{{DM_FixedFOV}}' == '1' ]] && FLAGS=$((FLAGS | 32768)); CFG='{{$FullBaseDir}}baseq2/amp-server.cfg'; mkdir -p \"$(dirname \"$CFG\")\"; touch \"$CFG\"; if grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*set[[:space:]]+dmflags[[:space:]]' \"$CFG\"; then sed -i -E \"s|^[[:space:]]*set[[:space:]]+dmflags[[:space:]].*$|set dmflags \\\"$FLAGS\\\"|\" \"$CFG\"; else printf 'set dmflags \\\"%s\\\"\\n' \"$FLAGS\" >> \"$CFG\"; fi; echo \"Calculated Quake II dmflags: $FLAGS\""
